data.content_ref: inline:The inheritance relation asserts a shared abstraction across SRC_002 and SRC_001/SRC_005, but the refutation condition is self-defeating: it says the relation is refuted if SRC_005/SRC_001 'can be fully described without any notion of an unstated or hidden axiom.' Yet SRC_001 itself explicitly says the axiom is 'stipulated away by the problem's own design' — meaning the problem supplies the axiom. If the problem supplies it, it is neither unstated nor hidden; it is built into the exercise. By the target's own refutation clause, describing SRC_001 as 'the problem encodes the assumption so the answer is mechanically determined' is a description that contains no notion of an unstated or hidden axiom (the axiom is stated-by-design). So the relation triggers its own refutation: the very characterization of SRC_001 that the relation provides satisfies the disjunct that refutes it.
